caption: Air flow through the Fleisch mesh creates a 0.75 cm H2O drop at 0.5 L/s; the differential transducer and carrier amplifier produce the flow signal, and the integrator gives 0.5 L in 1 s. Follow the chain from mesh to volume.

spec.title: Pneumotachometer and pressure measurement
spec.aria: Air passing through the mesh creates a pressure drop that a differential transducer converts to flow, and the flow signal is integrated to give volume.
